l1_words.meaning: a projection, such as a forecast or a projected figure
a general direction in which something is changing
a diagram or chart showing data

pattern_explanation: Ukrainian borrowed many technical and business terms from English, French and German, and English drew on the same sources, so many forms look alike. Over time some words narrowed or shifted in meaning in one language, which is why look-alike pairs can mislead learners.
false_friend_warning: The Ukrainian word transliterated as 'aktualnyi' looks like the English word 'actual', but it means relevant or topical, not real or existing. Learners who expect the English meaning will misread sentences about current data as talking about factual data.
